title: Top 5 Electric Scooters in India for 2025: Performance, Price & Range Compared

blocks.heading: Top 5 Electric Scooters in India for 2025: Performance, Price & Range Compared
blocks.content:
Electric scooters are no longer just the future in India—they're here and taking over our roads. With skyrocketing fuel prices and people getting more eco-conscious, EV two-wheelers are now a smart and stylish way to move around. But with so many models buzzing into the market, how do you pick the right one?

Don't worry—we've done the legwork for you. Here's a fun and informative roundup of the top 5 electric scooters in India for 2025!

blocks.heading: The Top 5 Electric Scooters
blocks.content:
**1. Ola S1X+**
• Price: Approx. ₹1.10 lakh
• Range: 108 km
• Top Speed: 101 km/h
• Charging Time (0-80%): 6 hours

Ola's S1X+ is a head-turner with sleek looks, voice-enabled features, and a powerful MoveOS platform.

**2. Ather Rizta**
• Price: Starts ₹1.05 lakh
• Range: 123 km
• Top Speed: 80 km/h
• Charging Time (0-80%): 6.5 hours

Ather's most family-focused scooter yet, the Rizta comes with a wider seat and upgraded safety features.

**3. TVS iQube ST**
• Price: Around ₹1.40 lakh
• Range: 100km
• Top Speed: 82 km/h
• Charging Time: ~3 hours (0-80%)

TVS's iQube ST is a solid choice if comfort and quality matter. Plus, it has a clean, intuitive dashboard.

**4. Bajaj Chetak Premium**
• Price: ₹1.35 lakh
• Range: 153 km
• Top Speed: 73 km/h
• Charging Time (0-80%): 3 hours

Old-school charm meets modern EV tech. Bajaj Chetak has that premium feel and smooth ride quality.

**5. Hero Vida V1 Plus**
• Price: ₹85K
• Range: 94 km
• Top Speed: 69 km/h
• Charging Time (0-80%): 3.5 hours

Hero's Vida V1 Plus gives you swappable battery convenience and a simple, stylish design.

blocks.heading: Which One's Right for You?
blocks.content:
• **Daily commuting**: Ather Rizta or TVS iQube ST offer comfort and great range.
• **Tech enthusiasts**: Go for Ola S1X+—it's got smart moves.
• **Retro lovers**: Bajaj Chetak is elegant and timeless.
• **Budget buyers**: Hero Vida V1 Plus offers solid value.

EVs are more than a trend—they're becoming a lifestyle choice. Whichever scooter you pick, you'll be saving money, reducing emissions, and gliding through traffic like a boss.
